svg.title: PB-MO-004 stack mould machining blueprint
svg.text: SCALE 1:3 · ELONGATED CAVITY 10.00 DEEP, 8 TEETH 8.40 HIGH
SCALE 1:3 · HYBRID CAVITY 10.00 DEEP, 8 TEETH 8.40 HIGH
SCALE 1:3 · TEETH SIDE UP · SEAT FACE Z−10, 9 TEETH 8.40 HIGH (ELONGATED)
SCALE 1:3 · TEETH SIDE UP · SEAT FACE Z−10, 9 TEETH 8.40 HIGH (HYBRID)
SCALE 2:1 · MAIN PLATE ACROSS THE TEETH AT X250
SCALE 2:1 · ALONG A TOOTH: THE 45° RAMP
SCALE 2:1 · CLAMP PLATE ACROSS THE TEETH AT X250
B: M6 STACK BOLTS (SPOT 0.4×45°). D: DOWEL PINS Ø6 h6, GROUND.
ROOT W AT THE FLOOR / SEAT, TIP W 8.40 ABOVE; BOTH SIDES 1.5°. RAMP 45° AT THE X-FROM END,
WHERE THE TOOTH ROOT STARTS AT X150 (ELSE THE FRAME LINE CUTS IT). HY CLAMP: OUTER TEETH CUT TO 4.83.
MATERIAL: ALUMINIUM 6061-T651 OR CAST TOOLING PLATE (ALCA 5 / MIC-6). BLANKS 445 × 260: MAIN PLATE 30 THICK (FACES AS SUPPLIED),
CLAMP PLATES 20 THICK (BACK AS SUPPLIED). STEP: output/mould/mould_*.step. PROGRAMS: PB-MO-005.
DATUM (ALL FACES): G54 X0 ON THE PADDLE BUTT REFERENCE, Y0 ON THE CENTRE LINE, Z0 ON THE TOP OF THE STOCK. X ALONG
THE PLATE (HANDLE TOWARDS -X). EVERY FACE IS SYMMETRIC ABOUT Y0; FACE B IS MACHINED TURNED OVER ABOUT X.
TOLERANCES UNLESS STATED: ISO 2768-mK. CAVITY DEPTH 10.00 ±0.02, TOOTH HEIGHT 8.40 ±0.02, TOOTH WIDTHS ±0.02,
SEAT FACE TO TOOTH TIPS 8.40 ±0.02, HOLE POSITIONS ±0.02, DOWEL HOLES Ø6 H7 (REAMED).
TOOTH SIDES 1.5° DRAFT EACH SIDE (WIDER AT THE ROOT), CUT BY A 1.5°/SIDE TAPERED END MILL; THE SIDES OF A TOOTH
CUT OFF BY THE FRAME LINE ALSO GET 1.5° (≤ 0.22 OFF THE CAD AT THE TIP: THE PART'S FRAME 0.22 THICKER = MORE RELEASE).
TOOTH HANDLE ENDS: 45° RAMPS (ROOT AT X150, TIP AT X158.4), BALL-NOSE FINISH, ≤ R0.25 LEFT AT THE ROOT. CAVITY
CORNERS AT THE BUTT R3 (TOOL), NOTCH CORNERS R3. ALL OTHER EDGES SHARP AS DRAWN.
SURFACES IN CONTACT WITH THE PART (CAVITY FLOOR AND WALL, TEETH, SEAT FACES): Ra 0.8 MACHINED, THEN POLISH TO
Ra 0.4 (P800 → P1500 → POLISH) FOR RELEASE. OTHER SURFACES Ra 3.2. DEBURR 0.2 EXCEPT THE CAVITY AND TOOTH EDGES.
OVERFLOW GROOVE 2 × 1.5 AT 2 FROM THE CAVITY EDGE; 6 VENTS 2 × 0.8 TO THE PLATE EDGE; PRY NOTCHES 14 × 6 × 2.5
AT BOTH PARTING FACES (CLAMP PLATES: IN THE SEAT FACE).
CHECK BEFORE USE: STACK CLOSES ON THE 2 DOWEL PINS WITH BOTH TRIAL RIB SUPPORTS (PLA PRINTS) IN PLACE; CLAMP
PLATES SEAT FLAT (0.02 FEELER MUST NOT ENTER). MOULD USE AND CURE: PB-MO-003 (WARM CURE UP TO 120 °C).
ALUMINIUM MAIN PLATE 30 + 2 CLAMP PLATES (BLANK 20) · MACHINING DATA FOR PB-MO-003 · G54 / 2 DOWELS
